phases.docker_start: docker run -d --rm --name eval-pg-20 -p 5455:5432 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=eval -e POSTGRES_DB=evaldb postgres:16-alpine; pg_isready returns ready on attempt 1
phases.seed_table: docker exec eval-pg-20 psql -U postgres -d evaldb -c 'CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT); INSERT INTO users (name,email) VALUES ("alice",...),("bob",...),("carol",...);' returns 'CREATE TABLE; INSERT 0 3'
phases.gather_run_1: POSTGRES_PASSWORD=eval node run.mjs > dispatch-result.json (cwd=<work>); exit=0; envelope.status=success; data.rows[0].table_name=users
phases.gather_run_2: POSTGRES_PASSWORD=eval node run.mjs > dispatch-result-2.json (cwd=<work>); exit=0; envelope identical to run 1
phases.events_logged: two op=ingest entries in log/events.jsonl, one per gather run
phases.verify_no_leak: docker exec eval-pg-20 psql -c 'SELECT pid, application_name, state FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=evaldb AND state IS NOT NULL' returns only the psql session — connector pool was released on each Node exit
phases.docker_stop: docker stop eval-pg-20 (idempotent; tolerates already-stopped containers)
